⚙ Parent: arrows before testing

No timer. No lost lives. Notes stay until you change the level. Badges stay on this browser.

Little steps. Big ideas.

🐾

Walk Puppy: green arrows move Puppy straight away. Glowing squares are safe places to step. Trees and locked gates stay in the way, but there is no penalty.

📝

My path notes: each move appears here automatically. Undo removes the last step. Hide your notes for a memory challenge.

🧩

Build code: purple arrows add instructions. Puppy returns to the start. Use your notes, but build your code yourself.

▶

Test code: watch Puppy follow your instructions. Tap any block to change its direction or insert a missing move. Undo brings back your last edit.

🏅

Every solved program counts! A shorter program earns an optional gold badge.

Teacher on / off controls speech and celebrations. Footsteps have their own sound switch below the board.
